question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

NE - MF -LG

LS - KT- JU
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768ffa75a91f088695c16a6deb50b713a526fcdb17ebb80961c20654cb850baa.png] 

The logic used here is that -1 and +1 has been done in the first letter and second letter respectively to get the next cluster.

The pattern followed here is:

 
• **NE - MF -LG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e86c3b326cf0fac6d8c02fd29e246f20774aaf505fbbe0fc3f6145682c12eb81.png] 

 
• **LS - KT- JU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f34725caf217fca5a6626d2d0e3c7d40d69661c9c2b078d467800c6bf91c7d9.png] 

From the given options, the correct answer is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d8e107c9cdcd1ae766a1a2671682da1c6b3698411724306adcfe84c5049b48f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **' AV - ZW - YX ****'**.
